title: Iron Crown - A dungeon crawler tale. by Majicraft's Lab
author: lordpoee
selftext:
Many of you asked for a demo of my D&D dungeon crawler. I have spent the past two days addressing the foreground masking system, adding proper death sprites and sound FX/music etc.   
I have done my very best to find bugs or weirdness, so should you find any- please let me know. :)  
**Have fun!**

**Link:**  
[**https://majicraft.itch.io/iron-crown-a-dungeon-crawler-tale**](https://majicraft.itch.io/iron-crown-a-dungeon-crawler-tale)

comments.author: scratchieee
comments.body: Another AI slop dungeon crawler with art that doesn't match or mesh with the background at all.

replies.body: I bet you looked at the screenshot and didn't even play it. It does match and mesh, in fact, I added a foreground masking system do party members and enemies can appear to be standing behind objects. You comment is not useful or truthful in the slightest.
